methodology.source: triverna.pl hotel page, date-picker calendar grid + 'Do zaplaty brutto' total
methodology.calendar_trick: Click the arrival date field -> calendar shows nightly rates for the whole month. Arrow forward for subsequent months. One zoom = one month.
methodology.room_param_note: CONFIRMED AGAIN: no room= URL param needed. Bare slug works. Sequence: click arrival date -> click departure date -> OSOB dropdown auto-opens, pick 2 -> room radio list appears with cheapest room preselected -> DZIECI dropdown -> 1 -> 'Liczba przekracza limit' -> 'Dodaj 1 dostawke'.
methodology.ui_layout_warning: The widget COLLAPSES the calendars after dates are set, so every click shifts the panel upward. Re-screenshot before each click; do not trust the fixed coordinates in prompt section 4.
methodology.counter_timing: CONFIRMED: 'Do zaplaty brutto' counter needs 50-70 SECONDS to settle, not 6-8. Observed Carynska 21 -> 177 -> 322 -> 626 -> 636 -> 699 -> 808 -> 1032 -> 1103 -> 1110 over ~68s; Bachledka 74 -> 383 -> 1056 -> 1533 -> 1739 -> 1830 over ~60s. Poll until two consecutive reads match.
methodology.caution: Calendar cell = lowest nightly rate of the CHEAPEST room in the offer, not necessarily the room that fits 3. Formulas below convert calendar rates to the real total.
